program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((frames
           (filter
             (lambda (obj)
               (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
                      (r0 (first bb))
                      (c0 (second bb))
                      (r1 (third bb))
                      (c1 (fourth bb)))
                 (and (= (obj-color obj) 1)
                      (all?
                        (lambda (p)
                          (let ((pr (fst p)) (pc (snd p)))
                            (= (cell-at g pr pc) 1)))
                        (filter
                          (lambda (p)
                            (let ((pr (fst p)) (pc (snd p)))
                              (or (= pr r0) (= pr r1) (= pc c0) (= pc c1))))
                          (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r1 c1))))))
             (objects g 0)))
         (seeded
           (filter
             (lambda (obj)
               (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
                      (r0 (first bb))
                      (c0 (second bb))
                      (r1 (third bb))
                      (c1 (fourth bb)))
                 (any?
                   (lambda (p) (= (cell-at g (fst p) (snd p)) 2))
                   (positions-in-rect (+ r0 1) (+ c0 1) (- r1 1) (- c1 1)))))
             frames)))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (if (any?
              (lambda (obj)
                (let ((bb (obj-bbox obj)))
                  (and (> r (first bb)) (< r (third bb))
                       (> c (second bb)) (< c (fourth bb)))))
              seeded)
            4
            (cell-at g r c))))))
